Title: Trolls Bridge 2
review: 7,"Trolls Bridge 2 (Yggdrasil): OverviewTrolls Bridge 2 is a 5-reel, 25 payline slot powered by Yggdrasil Gaming and a follow up to the 2017 release Trolls Bridge. With improved graphics and more action-packed than ever before, you once again get to enter the fairy-tale fantasy world of Yggdrasil's crazy trolls where you'll encounter colossal symbols, random multipliers, a bonus cauldron feature, and a free spins game where each round is different in setup from the other. Accessible via your desktop or mobile device, this medium variance slot can be played from 10 cents up to 140€/$ per spin.Although some of the childish and quirky charisma of the original still shines through, you'll find the sequel to be significantly darker, both visually and aurally. Not only has the quality of the visual design greatly improved, so has the building technique of the trolls. Instead of a rickety wooden fence, the troll fortress is now an intimidating stone structure decorated with spikes, flames, human skulls and red banners to signal doom and destruction.Free spins feature in actionWith the reels set over an intimidating drawbridge and a sinister soundtrack serving as the troll anthem, symbols include diamond, club, spade and heart card suits. More rewarding are the four troll picture symbols that can appear as 2x2 and 2x4 colossal symbols. The most lucrative of these is the red-haired troll, giving you 10 times your stake for five of a kind. There's also a golden wild symbol included in the game which substitutes for all symbols except the scatter.Trolls Bridge 2 (Yggdrasil): FeaturesFans of the original game will find Trolls Bridge 2 to be just as action-packed and feature-heavy. Before anything else, however, you'll need to make an active decision whether to play with the Golden Bet activated or not. Similar to the classic Yggdrasil game Golden Fish Tank, activating the Golden Bet will give you an extra feature pick in the free spins game and boost the RTP of the game by 0.6%, but it will also increase the cost of your spins by 40%.Once you've made your call, keep an eye out for the skull scatter symbol as 3 or more anywhere in view will activate the Free Spins - 3, 4 or 5 scatter symbols will give you 6, 8 or 10 spins with 3, 4 or 5 feature picks respectively. Before the action starts, you'll see a wall with 18 skulls and asked to use your picks to reveal your feature combo. This can include extra picks, additional free spins, random wilds on every spin, colossal symbols and symbol upgrades. With 18 different features on offer, no two free spins rounds are likely to be the same.In the main game, the Bonus Cauldron feature will trigger if the cauldron symbol lands on the last reel. Similar to the chest feature in Yggdrasil's Vikings series, it will either give you a cash prize of up to 50 times your stake or entry to the free spins game.Colossal Symbols do not only appear in the free spins feature but can hit randomly in the main game as well. On any spin, 2x4 colossal troll symbols can hit anywhere on the reels to increase your chance of landing big wins.Finally, a Bonus Stone feature might come into play following a winning spin in the main game. If randomly activated, you'll see a boulder catapulted at the reels with a multiplier attached that can boost your wins by up to 5x.Trolls Bridge 2 (Yggdrasil): VerdictTrolls Bridge 2 is a game that utilities the same fundamental mechanic as many other popular Yggdrasil titles such as Golden Fish Tank, Vikings Go To Hell, Lucha Maniacs and, of course, the original Trolls Bridge. And while there's a lot to like about it, in particular the stellar graphics and the entertaining free spins feature, there are also some factors that can put some players off. For example, all the base game features that seemed so intriguing at first eventually start to feel useless as the payouts, even with the help of colossal symbols and random multipliers, are quite low in general.With that said, it's well worth a try, especially if you're into previously mentioned games, as the free spins feature is entertaining enough to make up for the mediocre base game. Don't expect any life-changing wins, however. The original version offers a max win of around 2000x and Trolls Bridge 2 is likely in the same ballpark."
structured_summary: Trolls Bridge 2 immerses players in a darker fairy-tale world filled with mischievous trolls. The game boasts features like colossal symbols, random multipliers, and a customizable free spins game with a Golden Bet option. The review praises the improved graphics and entertaining features but notes that base game payouts can feel underwhelming. Title: Merlin's Moneyburst
review: 7,"Merlin's Moneyburst: ReviewIt must be quite comfy to be part of the Scientific Games family. If you run out of creative energy, you can always build yourself a Frankenstein slot using bits and pieces from other software developers, an opportunity NextGen Gaming has not passed up on. In the studio's third, or fourth (who knows), instalment in the Merlin series, the Moneyburst game engine has been borrowed from sister company WMS to lay the foundation. Those of you who have been around for some time will instantly think of classic WMS titles such as Bruce Lee, Fire Queen, Glitz or Queens Knight II when Merlin's Moneyburst loads up on the screen.Indeed, it comes with 60 paylines and the same odd reel arrangement made up of 4 single reels in a 2x2 formation followed by 3 reels with 4 symbols each. Playable on all devices from 30 cents t0 62.50€ per spin, this rather childish looking fantasy-themed game has plenty of diverse features to keep you busy throughout, such as respins, wild modifier extras, and a free spins game in which Mr Merlin himself makes an appearance.Maybe even more so than in previous titles in the series, Merlin's Moneyburst looks like an educational pc game for 6-year old kids to learn their ABC's. Take the cartoon-like royal symbols for example with their quirky eyes following your mouse pointer as you move it around - your toddler will love this game. Visually, it looks alright, although it has a slightly dated aura, especially when it comes to the cringy wizard animations.Set in an enchanted moonlit forest, on the reels you will see A, K, Q, J and 10 royal values (with eyes) alongside time glasses, money bags and bottles of potion. The spell-book is the most lucrative with 5 on a full payline yielding 8,33 times your stake. As you would expect, Merlin is the wild and substitutes for all symbols bar the scatter. Land 5 of him on a payline and you'll win 83.33 times your stake.Merlin's Moneyburst: FeaturesFree spin featureMaking use of the studios own in-house developed SuperBet feature, players can choose from a set of additional wagers with multipliers. This comes to use when the Merlin wild hits, as it can boost your winning combinations with multipliers of up to 10x. These are the available bet levels:Bet Level 1: play from 60 cents t0 15€ per spin - any winning combination that includes a wild symbol will receive a 2x multiplier boost (95.75% RTP).Bet Level 2: play from 1 t0 25€ per spin - any winning combination that includes a wild symbol will receive a 4x multiplier boost (96.00% RTP).Bet Level 3: play from 1.50 t0 37.50€ per spin - any winning combination that includes a wild symbol will receive a 6x multiplier boost (96.25% RTP).Bet Level 4: play from 2 t0 50€ per spin - any winning combination that includes a wild symbol will receive a 8x multiplier boost (96.50% RTP).Bet Level 5: play from 2.50 t0 62.50€ per spin - any winning combination that includes a wild symbol will receive a 10x multiplier boost (96.75% RTP).There are in total 3 features included in Merlin's Moneyburst. The least attractive one is the Merlin's Held Respins feature, which is also by far the most frequently triggered feature. It comes into play if the 2x2 reel formation contains matching symbols. Starting with 5 respins, the symbols on the 2x2 formation are held in position while the other 3 reels continue to spin. Additionally, the Merlin may appear, randomly transforming regular symbols into wilds. 3 scatters during the feature will add another 5 respins to your total.The second best feature to trigger is the Merlin's Free Games feature, which is played when you land 3 claw scatter symbols on reels 3, 4 and 5 on the same spin. Starting with 10 free spins, the Merlin may randomly appear to add stacked wilds on reels 3, 4 and 5. Moreover, it's possible to retrigger the feature to give you another 10 free spins. Potentially, you can also trigger the Merlin's Held Respins feature here.The highlight in Merlin's Moneburst is the Merlin's Wild Spins feature. In the streaming community, this rare feature is informally referred to as the ""Double Bonus"", and has generated some truly epic wins on the Bruce Lee slot throughout the years. The Merlin's Wild Spins come into play if you land matching symbols on the 2x2 reel formation along with 3 scatters, all on the same spin. Once triggered, you will benefit from all symbols on the 2x2 reel formation turning into wilds with the Merlin emerging on each spin to add stacked wilds on the other 3 reels. You can retrigger this feature as well, adding another 10 wild spins to your total.Merlin's Moneyburst: Final VerdictMerlin's Moneyburst is a rather blunt fusion of the classic Bruce Lee mechanic and the Merlin series. Fundamentally, the two games are the same, but the addition of the SuperBet feature does make Merlin quite a bit more volatile. Furthermore, whilst Bruce Lee offers a slightly higher RTP of around 96%, Merlin's Moneburst comes in at only 95.50% with the SuperBet feature deactivated. Increasing the SuperBet level will increase the RTP, but in turn, it also makes the game more volatile and expensive to play.Just like in Bruce Lee, there's plenty of potential to unlock here. The payouts in the Respins feature and the Free Spins Game are usually not all that exciting, but if you're lucky enough to trigger the Merlin's Wild Spins, you can almost certainly look forward to a 1000x-4000x feature. Add the 10x SuperBet on top of this and well, you do the math. Overall, Merlin's Moneyburst is a decent revamp of Bruce Lee that delivers all the goodies from the original, but with a bit more bite for those who like it rough. If you can live with the designed-for-toddlers look and feel, it's actually a competent slot."
structured_summary: Merlin's Moneyburst is a fantasy-themed slot with an enchanted forest setting, drawing on elements from previous games in the series. It features 60 paylines, a unique reel setup, and engaging features like respins, wild modifiers, and free spins with multiplier options. The reviewer finds it visually dated but appreciates the varied gameplay and potential for big wins. The game has a cartoonish aesthetic with playful animations, appealing to a younger audience.

Title: Oops
review: "May 9, 2025",8,"Oops: Slot OverviewIf the thought of viruses, genetic mutations, or sickness in general makes you want to flee the germ-ridden world to live in a bubble, it might be best to look away now. Software provider Shady Lady has delved into the world of scientific research to explore what happens when viral DNA runs amok and has come up with the aptly titled online slot Oops. Inspired by the pandemic that is technically 'over' yet still lingers in the collective consciousness, this is a humorous take on science, human error, and the age-old question of just cos we can do something, should we?Deep in the bowels of the earth lies a governmental research centre run by a team of scientists - one of whom, rather amusingly, bears a striking resemblance to Anders Tegnell, Sweden's former state epidemiologist - who, unfortunately, through sheer ineptitude, have lost control of their experiments and spawned a suspicious slimy substance. Adding to their woes, the slime has infected a group of lab mice, which have escaped and triggered a worldwide global panic. Oops plays this out in a humorous slapstick manner, but really, the fact this could conceivably happen means the game tickles a deep-seated existential dread that humanity's days could be numbered, and we have no one else but ourselves to blame.Oops slot - base gamePlayers get the experimentation going by picking a stake of 10 c to $/€100, while bonus buys, boosters, and more are optional extras. Hitting play spins a 6x4 gaming area with 4,096 ways to win by default but going up to a possible 262,144 should the splitting feature in free spins reach full capacity. When regular betting, the RTP comes in at 96.28%, and Shady Lady has rated the volatility as 10 out of 10.Five unsanitary-looking items make up Oops' low pay symbols - a shoe, a glove, a sandwich, underpants, and a syringe, while its high pays are 4 unusual character symbols. Winning combinations of 6 OAK in length pay 0.5x to 1x the bet for the items or 1.5x to 3x the bet for the character symbols. Wild symbols must have mutated out of existence because there aren't any to be found while playing Oops.Oops: Slot FeaturesOops slot - free spinsBrewing in Oops' feature lab are base game only flu-like features, a multi-mutation level free spins round, bonus boosters, bonus buys, highlight reels, and loot boxes.Flu Like FeaturesIn the base game, 1 of 3 flu-like features may randomly trigger on any spin. Only one may trigger per round. After appearing, all mystery symbols they produce reveal matching symbols:Fever - a random number of columns (1 to 6) are filled with slimy mystery reveal symbols.Cough - 3 to 20 random positions on the grid are covered in mucous mystery reveal symbols.Congestion - a cluster of gooey mystery reveal symbols (4 to 16) covers part of the gaming area.Pandemic Free SpinsLanding 3 or more Lab Rat scatters triggers the Pandemic free spins round. Three scatters award 6 free spins, plus 1 free spin is awarded for each additional triggering scatter. During free spins, Virus symbols may appear and either split or spread. A Virus can spread left, right, up, or down as long as the adjacent position does not already contain a Virus symbol. Splitting creates 2 copies of the Virus on the current position. After spreading, viruses transform into matching regular symbols.There are 5 mutation levels, which are upgraded by collecting 3 Mutation symbols. The number of Virus actions depends on the mutation level. At level 1, a single action is made; at level 2, 2 actions are made, and so on. When a mutation level is upgraded, +3 spins are awarded.Feature BuysBonus Boost increases the bet by 1.5x to increase the chance of triggering features. The Big Bonus Bet ups the stake by 5x to increase the feature triggering chances even further. By paying 89x, players can guarantee free spins trigger on the next spin. Highlight Reels, meanwhile, lets players buy a batch of spins and play out the 3 highest-paying results. Spins are presented in ascending win order. The top 3 results of 100, 300, or 500 spins cost 75x, 190x, or 292x the bet, respectively. Lastly, opting for the Loot Box feature awards a random prize from 9 Enhanced Bonuses across Bronze, Silver, and Gold tiers. A Rare Loot Box, Epic Loot Box or Legendary Loot Box costs 188x, 347x, or 574x the bet, respectively.Oops slot - free spinsOops: Slot VerdictDive down the rabbit hole, and you may start wondering why humanity hasn't already had its own extinction-level oops moment and been entirely wiped out by a lab-brewed virus. We trust our governments know what they are doing, or if not, we generally assume the scientists and people in white coats have a handle on things at least. After all, people are living longer, healthier lives than ever due in part to modern medicine, and the assumption is this will only get better as time passes. But what if we're wrong? Well, Oops provides a possible answer to this question, and it is actually a little bit frightening. Fortunately, all the slimy virus stuff is done in jest (right?), so fingers crossed Oops is simply a rib-tickling look at scientific ineptitude rather than a premonition of the future.It's also a thoroughly entertaining slot and a solid continuation of Shady Lady's strong launch into the gambling market, following on from Devil's Finger and Brainwashed. The Dual Spin mechanic continues the studio's focus on player input. Whether the Dual Spin causes excitement or not, it's always interesting to see a studio trying something new. 4ThePlayer still fly relatively low beneath the radar, but they clearly aren't content to stay there or ride the coattails of others.Like 6 Wild Sharks, which came out around the same time, 2 Gods Zeus vs Thor is further proof of a studio that likes to experiment. Even if the two-button thing comes across a little too wacky for some purists, it beats cranking out generic white bread slots or going down the tempting route of copying classic games.For a bit of critique, the roulette-style win tracker is cute, but ultimately useless when selecting which button to hit. For the record, Win Spins theoretically trigger every 185 regular spins.Once again, 4ThePlayer has crafted an original game which works pretty well for the most part. 2 Gods Zeus vs Thor doesn't feel like a slot that's trying to be different just for the sake of it. review: 2024",5,"Clover Craze: Slot OverviewFour-leaf clovers have been associated by some with good luck, though where the idea came from isn't very clear. For one thing, Green Clovers and Golden Clovers are wilds, substituting for all paying symbols.Green Clover – a wild that lands on reels 2, 3, and 4. They cover the entire reel if they can form part of a winning combination after doing so .Golden Clover – a wild that lands on the center reel. When it lands in the middle of the reel, it triggers Golden Clover features. If a Golden Clover lands, but it is not in the middle of the reel, it transforms into a Green Clover.Golden Clover x3 – landing a Golden Clover in the middle of the center reel and a Green Clover on an adjacent reel forms a Big Golden Clover 2x3 in size with an x3 win multiplier.Golden Clover x7 – landing a Golden Clover in the middle of the center reel and Green Clovers on both adjacent reels forms a Huge Golden Clover 3x3 in size with an x7 win multiplier.Golden X Clover – landing a Golden Clover in the middle of the center reel and no Green Clovers, Sevens, or Bells land on adjacent reels means the Golden Clover clones on the top and bottom positions of both adjacent reels, creating an X shape.Golden Clover Cash RespinsLanding a Golden Clover on the middle of the center reel and either a 7 of a bell symbol on an adjacent reel triggers Cash Respins. First, the Golden Clover clones itself on the whole reel, and any wins this creates are paid out. Next, all symbols of the same type as the one which triggered the Cash Respin (sevens or bells) turn golden and get a cash prize representing a stake multiplier: 7s get a cash prize of 3x, while bells get a cash prize of 2x. Only one type of symbol triggers respins. If both a 7 and a bell symbol land on adjacent reels, Cash Respins are triggered by the higher prize symbol, the 7. After that respins start.Once underway, 3 respins are awarded where only the symbols of the type which triggered them are active. Landing a new symbol of that type locks them and resets the spin count back to 3. Respins end when no new symbols of the required type land in 3 consecutive respins. When respins end, all cash prizes are added up and awarded. Golden Clovers count as cash prizes. It's possible to trigger the Golden Clover x3 and Cash Respins feature. When this happens, the x3 win multiplier of the Big Golden Clover is removed at the start of the respin and does not apply to any wins. The 2x3 Golden Clover counts as 6 cash prize symbols.Feature BuyFrom the feature buy section, players can buy a spin landing a guaranteed Green Clover for 5x the stake, a spin landing a guaranteed Golden Clover in the middle of the grid for 25x the bet, a spin landing a guaranteed Golden Clover x3 feature for 50x the bet, or a spin landing a guaranteed Golden Clover x7 feature for 500x the bet.Clover Craze slot - x7 Golden cloverClover Craze: Slot VerdictWhat looked like a pretty generic fruit slot at first, just one with a lot more clovers than usual, turned out to have deeper and, at times, fiendish gameplay going on. Again, it could have been a coincidence, but it got a bit ridiculous after a while and the predictability sort of ruined the excitement.Release the Kraken appears to use a similar math model to other recent Pragmatic Play slots. Sure, every session is different, and everyone has different results. There are epic wins of course, or Kraken Wins as the game calls them, here. Just be wary. Title: Golden Fish Tank 2 Gigablox
review: 7.5,"Golden Fish Tank 2 Gigablox: Slot OverviewSome people like to get out amongst nature, wrestle fish, show 'em who's boss and maybe haul a few on to land. Others prefer to bring nature to them and watch fish do laps in a fishbowl, maybe swim in and out of little, tiny shipwrecks or plastic weeds. The studio has leant this out to a number of its partners, for better or worse, yet it works like a charm in Golden Fish Tank 2. Basically, the game has 6 reels. However, reels merge on every spin to create Gigablox symbols sized 2x2, 3x3, or 4x4 – in the base game. When part of a win, Gigablox symbols break down into regular 1x1 sized symbols for the payout evaluation.Mathematically, things have moved on as well. Volatility, for starters, has been increased from medium to medium-high, though RTP has remained about the same at 96%. Low pay symbols are made up of the four card suits, while the four high pays look like really bewildered versions of the four fish that appeared in the original. In free spins, it is possible to win 2-500x the bet or 1-5 extra free spins. The bigger the chest, the better the average prize.Free SpinsLanding at least 5 scatter symbols in the base game triggers the free spins feature. The number of free spins symbols in view is the number of awarded spins. Next, players receive a random number of feature picks. If you are using the Golden Bet, you always get 1 extra feature pick here.However, if you are not happy with the number of feature picks, you can gamble for more. To do so, 3 starfish appear on screen. Players pick one, and if it reveals gold, you win another feature pick. If it reveals a black starfish, you are sent back to the base game.A bunch of undersea items appear on the screen for the feature pick. Players click the objects one at a time to reveal these modifiers:Wild Fish – one of the fish symbols is turned wild.x2 Multiplier – is applied to all wins in free spins.Expanded Reels – 2 rows are added to the reels. This allows Gigablox up to 6x6.Extra Wild – 1 to 2 wilds are added in random positions on each free spin.Fish Stacks – one fish symbol type can land stacked on the reels.Extra Free Spins – 1 to 5 free spins are added to the total.Buy BonusPlayers get 2 options for buying their way to the bonus round. The first is the standard bet option which awards 5-16 free spins for 60x the total stake. The second is with the Golden Bet switched on, so players get the +1 pick; this costs 100x the stake.Golden Fish Tank 2 Gigablox: Slot VerdictYou could say Gigablox has taken to Yggdrasil's classic like a fish to water. Sorry, that was terrible, but it does describe Golden Fish Tank 2 quite well. Yggdrasil hasn't tinkered with the wrapper much, so players who liked the simple underwater scene of the first game will be chuffed that the studio has largely left it alone. If anything, they've simplified it even further, so if nothing particularly exciting is happening on the reels, it might be tempting to zone out for a bit to just watch the fish do their thing.Fortunately, Yggdrasil has programmed the game to avoid experiencing a lot of downtime. Gigablox keeps you second-guessing, intermittently linking up into something decent, and free spins seemed to trigger quite frequently on their own, without the need for activating the bonus buy. Like real-life fishing, the pick feature can be torturous, though, especially when you've maxed the number of picks and not collecting anything interesting from them. Without a combo made up of wilds, the x2 multiplier and the reel expanding modifier, chances are your wins are not going to be all that impressive.When compared to other Gigablox games Yggdrasil has done, Golden Fish Tank 2 isn't as exhilarating as, say, Hades Gigablox, but it goes for a different angle. Golden Fish Tank 2 offers a nice balance between chilling with nature and finely tuned mathematics. It's certainly a much higher performer than the first one. If you haven't played the original or haven't played it for a while, it'll be a shock to see the game advertising wins of up to x300. Perhaps this was no big deal back in 2016 when Golden Fish Tank was first released, but it seems bizarrely quaint when compared to Golden Fish Tank 2's stated 5,000x max win figure.The original was a huge success with its, at the time, cutting edge technology, design and features, so our expectations were high. Golden Fish Tank 2 is a neatly designed sequel, which integrates Gigablox like it was meant to be, yet there is a lingering feeling that the producers could have tried a wee bit harder."

Title: Tower Tumble
review: 6.5,"Tower Tumble (Relax Gaming): OverviewWhether Tower Tumble is to be regarded as a sequel to Temple Tumble or a standalone game is up for debate. It's undoubtedly a unique title. This time, the developers have shunned the Megaways game engine that came with Temple Tumble in favour of a toned down Tumble Reels system instead. Be warned - this is a cutesy slot set in a fantasy world that oozes pixie dust. Tower Tumble is also packed with features and reasonable payout potential, so let’s hold back on judgement until we’ve seen it all.Graphically, Tower Tumble isn’t bad and uses cartoon imagery to create its fantasy world in the countryside. It's bright, cheerful, and has a modern look. The action takes place on a 6x6 grid and at the start of each new base game tumble, only some of the symbols are revealed. The ones we get sit in the middle of the grid in a 2-4-4-2 formation. Surrounding them are stone blockers that can be removed as well some locked book symbols - more on these shortly.The symbols are all unique to the game and start with 4 coloured potions at the bottom end. The princess sits at the top along with the hero who is worth up to 30 times the stake. Like most slots with tumble style win systems, best payouts only usually happen when several combos cascade together on one spin. To help improve the winning possibilities, Tower Tumble comes with features that work in tandem to cause wins to snowball.Tower Tumble (Relax Gaming): FeaturesFree spins feature in actionThe grid system with the Tumble Reels feature forms the basis for most of the extras to launch from, so let’s start there. Instead of spinning reels, symbols tumble down to fill in the game grid. Along with the revealed symbols and the blocker tiles are 1-5 specially marked Elemental tiles.When a winning combo has formed, a couple of things happen. First, the winning symbols vanish off the screen and are replaced by fresh ones that tumble into the gaps and can trigger consecutive winners. Secondly, blocker tiles adjacent to the vanishing symbols are also removed which can reveal more standard pay symbols, wilds or unlock one of the Elemental tiles. This is what's on offer:Earth is the green book and removes 4-6 blocker tiles from the grid.Air is the purple book and creates a diagonal line of wilds starting from its position.Fire is the red book and changes a group of symbols into a common symbol.Water is the blue book and sprinkles 2-5 wilds on exposed spaces, but not over other wilds.Should players be lucky enough to clear all of the blocked tiles on one spin, then they are awarded with Free Spins. The aim of the game is to climb as high as you can up the tower. It starts with the player choosing one of 3 modes which effects the volatility of the bonus game as in previous Temple Tumble slots:Extra Spins - Low volatility with 10 free spins and no multipliers.Added Multipliers and Extra Spins - Med/High volatility with 8 free spins and a multiplier that goes up by 1 on every second new level.Added Multipliers - High volatility with 5 free spins and a multiplier that goes up by 1 on every new level.The bonus game starts at the base of the tower. Players are presented with a 4x4 grid of revealed symbols ringed by blocker tiles made from wood. With each win, blockers are removed, but they don’t reappear again on the next spin as they do in the base game. If they are all removed, then the player moves to the next level up the tower, and free spins are reset. Theoretically, players can smash their way through unlimited numbers of multipliers and levels. Technically they will end of course, but it’s a nice tagline.Tower Tumble (Relax Gaming): VerdictIn some ways, it's nice to take a break from the darker, more serious slots that we have reviewed recently, but Tower Tumble isn’t exactly the most exciting game on the market. In fact, it gets pretty boring, quite quickly. The main event is the free spins with their 'unlimited' multiplier. Yet, reality often doesn’t live up to the hype. There can be a lot of dead to low value spins on your path to trigger the Tower Climb feature and the road to get there wasn't quite the experience we expected.What makes it extra painful is that Tower Tumble isn’t really an improvement on Temple Tumble. Pay ways are less, the maximum potential of 5,150 times the stake is significantly lower, thrills are less. The only way Tower Tumble could possibly be a bigger draw is for players who go for this cutesy stuff. The way free spins are triggered by clearing the grid of blocked tiles isn’t super prevalent, but it's becoming more common. We saw it recently in NetEnt’s manic Reel Rush 2, and earlier this year with Thor’s Lightning to name two examples.At the end of the day, Tower Tumble has a respectable top payout, but so do many other better games. If you like your games to be a bit more original in both looks and feel we suggest you try Snake Arena from the same provider."

Title: Knight Fight
review: 2024",7,"Knight Fight: Slot OverviewSwedish software provider ELK Studios has turned out bundles of excitingly innovative online slots over the years, from the Gold games, the Nitropolis series, to the Toro lineup. One popular set of slots from the studio stars a gaggle of feisty avian entities in the team's Pirots range - to date, three of them have been released. When you're on to a good thing in the gambling industry, it makes a certain business sense to ride it out until the wheels fall off before abandoning the project for something new. In the spirit of squeezing extra mileage out of an entertaining concept comes Knight Fight, a revival of ELK Studios' CollectR mechanic and a reskin of Pirots 2.Knight Fight is not the first time ELK Studios has tangled with the medieval world. An earlier example was the cluster pays slot Micro Knights, and if you go back to take a look, the characters in both games are rather similar to each other, particularly that purple dragon. The same eccentric spirit has returned, gelling perfectly with the already eccentric nature of the Pirots games. Like Print Studios' Holy Hand Grenade, Knight Fight has a look and feel that isn't a million miles away from something Monty Python might have done if they'd been in the business of making slots. There's even a goat in this game, too.Knight Fight slot - base gameHitting the spin button, after picking a stake of 10 c to $/100, drops symbols and 4 collector knights onto a 6x6 gaming area. Knight Fight does not use lines, ways, scatter pays, or clusters to make wins. Instead, it relies on its CollectR mechanic and its 4 knights to travel around the board, where able, to collect pay symbols, feature symbols, and the like. There are four types of crest symbols; each type may be collected by a knight of the same colour. Crest symbols come in 7 value levels. The lowest levels are worth 0.05 to 0.1 times the bet; the highest is 10 to 50 times the bet. Wilds substitute for pay symbolsKnight Fight: Slot FeaturesKnight Fight slot - free spinsKnight Fight has 4 knight collector symbols that move around the reels in descending order of symbol value. Each knight is linked to a crest symbol of the same colour. Knights collect adjacent crest symbols of the same colour and feature symbols by moving orthogonally around the board. After all possible symbols have been collected, new symbols are dropped in to fill the gaps, pricing another chance for collecting. This means knights can move more than once on the same spin, including before a refill. Collecting a feature symbol triggers the symbol's feature.Symbol Collection MeterThe symbol collection meter keeps track of collected crest and wild symbols. The meter keeps collecting until the knights can't collect any more symbols. When the meter is full, one pending feature symbol release is added. Up to 3 feature symbol releases may be stacked at the same time. All stacked feature symbol releases are awarded at the same time. Feature symbol releases are awarded just before the goat turns evil, before the dragon flame strikes, as part of the first free spin, or when knights can't collect any more symbols. A feature symbol release converts a number of random crest symbols into random feature symbols. Aside from Scatters and Wilds, feature symbol types are:Coins - a collected coin symbol pays its displayed value. The MAX WIN coin awards the remaining amount needed to hit the maximum win.Upgrade Symbols - upgrades by 1-3 levels the payout level of crest symbols of the same colour as the knight that collected the upgrade symbol, up to 7. Collected upgrade all symbols upgrade all four crest symbols.Goat Symbols - when collected by a knight, it turns evil at the end of the spin when no more symbols can be collected. The knights are scared away from the grid, dropping them in new places.Transform Symbols - when collected, it transforms a cluster of crest symbols next to the knight into the same colour as the collecting knight. It may convert a random number of crest symbols into feature symbols.Golden Apple Basket Symbols - places Apples in empty spaces when collected. Knights can then cross these empty spaces one time each to reach symbols.Dragon Egg - a dragon egg or a dragon flame symbol collected by a knight triggers a dragon flame strike at the end of the spin when no more symbols can be collected. It removes knights and any symbols except feature symbols in close proximity to it, causing a redrop to fill the gaps. The dragon flame strike expands the grid up to 8x8. A collected Goat will trigger before a collected Dragon Egg.Adjacent knights may perform a Switcheroo where they swap places vertically or horizontally when they can collect more symbols. It may only happen if new clusters of symbols can be unlocked. If 3 or more knights end up horizontally and/or vertically next to each other, they fight on a random area of the grid. Scatters, coins, goats, and dragon egg symbols in the fight's path are collected, while crest symbols are removed. Knights redrop when the fight is over. A symbol drop refills the empty spaces.Free SpinsIf 3 scatter symbols are collected on a spin, 5 free spins are awarded. Free spins start with the current active number of rows and reels. The current collection meter progress is brought over, and any pending feature symbol releases are triggered on the first free spin. The grid size, progress on the symbol collection meter, payout level of crest symbols, and collection of scatter symbols are persistent in free spins. Collecting 3 scatter symbols awards additional free spins.X-iterKnight Fight's X-iter offers these bonus buys:Bonus Hunt - one spin with 4x the chance of triggering free spins for 3x the bet.Golden Apple Feast - one spin with the Golden Apple Basket feature triggered from the start for 10x the bet.Maximum Grid Size - one spin played with the maximum grid size for 25x the bet.Bonus - 100x the bet.Super Bonus - 500x the bet. ELK Studios isn't particularly big on clones and reskins, preferring to let their prodigious talent for taking players to new and exciting players pour forth in uniquely individual games. Oh sure, ELK has no qualms about running a series out over the course of years or making twists and turns to successful gameplay, but rarely do they bring back the exact same set of mechanics covered in a game world it's arguably explored before. This is not a complaint, a rage into the wind over the unfairness of life, but rather just an observation, ruminating on Knight Fight's family tree.Knights, after all, could pull out family trees called pedigrees to show who was the first in the family to attain a coat of arms. Knight Fight relies heavily on its 4 knights to drive the action, and the chaps here have about as much personality as the 4 parrots of the Pirots game did, being humorous to watch in action, darting about the grid, collecting stuff, getting into fisticuffs. You could say that technically, it is almost impossible not to be since the same features and gameplay have been brought over. The end result is a slot that's about on par with the game it was made from, not as must-see, let's say, but still a charming romp through the Middle Ages, collecting stuff along the way."

To activate that Alladin's cave of loot requires filling the grid with Lamp symbols, and since the grid has shrunk to a 5x3 number, it doesn't seem like a monumental challenge - in theory. In practice, well, good luck if you decide to take up the 10,000 Wonders Multimax chase.Why would a wide-eyed, hopeful gambler choose to do so? During free spins, Multiplier Trail values are x2, x5, x8, and x21 in default mode, or x5, x12, x21, and x50 with the Win Booster active. Factor in the 50x multiplier and genies can grant solid wins quick smart.Since everything else is dialed up, it might surprise you to know that the most you can win playing Aliya’s Wishes is 3,119 times your stake, which is practically the same as Jungle Jim’s. Title: Land Of The Free
review: "January 23, 2024",8,"﻿Land Of The Free: Slot Overview'O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave…' so wrote Francis Scott Key, lawyer and poet, in 'Defence of Fort M'Henry', a poem written during the War of 1812. Land Of The Free is also the title of Nolimit City's poke at certain aspects of American society, possibly angering some folk as much as it entertains others. Maybe more so. As a result, let's try to keep politics and whatnot out of the review, concentrating instead on the more mechanical and aesthetic aspects while players make their own minds up on the rest. So is Land Of The Free when measured in features. Its list includes Conveyor Belt features, scatters, Titan Spin/Idiot Spin, Tsunami Spins, Submerged Spins, and feature buys.Conveyor Belt FeaturesConveyor Belt Feature symbols appear on the conveyor belt beneath the main set of reels, acting like so:Protein Powder Keg – activated if there is a partially stacked symbol on the same reel. Converts a partially stacked symbol to a fully stacked symbol.Bottles – this is a crate with 1 or 2 bottles. If 1 bottle triggers, any random paying symbol on the same reel is converted into a wild. If it's 2 bottles, then the first bottle converts any random paying symbol on the same reel into Wild, while the second bottle splits that wild symbol into two parts.Benzo Bear – a half-stacked Benzo Bear exists only in the main game and converts 3 to 8 random symbols into wild and/or scatter. It appears half or fully stacked in the base game. During Tsunami Spins and Submerged Spins, Mr Split appears as a fully stacked symbol and splits all symbols that are below the water's surface. The Chainsaw is active if Mr Split is present on the unlocked reel. The Chainsaw adds 1 more split to the already split positions on the same reel it appeared.Rubber Ducks – when this appears during Tsunami Spins and/or Submerged Spins, it awards 2 spins per Rubber Duck. Each Rubber Duck increases the water level by one row during Tsunami Spins.ScattersScatters land on any reel in the base game. Hitting a scatter on reels 1 to 4 unlocks the rightmost reel. Hitting 3, 4, or 5 scatters triggers Tsunami spins, awarding 12, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively.Land Of The Free slot - Submerged SpinsTsunami Spins and Submerged SpinsAll reels are active during Tsunami Spins. If all 4 rows become covered by water, Tsunami Spins are upgraded to Submerged Spins, simply meaning all 4 rows are covered by water.Titan Spin/Idiot SpinIf a submarine enters on any spin in the main game or on Tsunami Spins or Submerged Spins, the Titan Spin feature triggers. Action Spins are another way of playing Land Of The Free at a brisker pace than usual.Land Of The Free slot - Titan SpinLand Of The Free: Slot VerdictNolimit City is no stranger to controversy, but they have really outdone themselves this time. Land Of The Free is either the funniest sh*t you've seen on the reels in a long time or the most offensive. Reactions may vary depending on what part of the world players reside in, maybe not. Best to look away now if Land Of The Free ain't your cup of tea. There are plenty of other slots out there that aren't trying to stir up as much humour, angst, lols, disgust, whatever, as Land Of The Free does. If nothing else, though, there is no denying Nolimit City is a creative bunch, willing to lead gamblers like a demented, or a genius, Pied Piper down paths never dreamed of before.What also appears evident is the extra care and thought Nolimit City poured into Land Of The Free than they did in the last game, Devil's Crossroad. The devil game was NLC's first release of 2024, and it feels like they saved their bigger ideas to ejaculate them across the reels in Land Of The Free. The game is rammed with Easter Eggs, with clever touches to be found at every turn. Ever met a stranger and hit upon a topic you both deeply relate to and you can't stop jabbering about? It feels like the topics in Land Of The Free were dear to Nolimit City's heart, and the team had a lot to say on the matter.And, while they were at it, the team jammed in a ton of good gameplay to match the theme blasts. Players really need to tread carefully here as it can burn you faster than a hot poker in a gunpowder barrel.In short, Land Of The Free should be a game which ticks a lot of the right boxes on NLC fans' checklists. It is absolutely chock full of irreverent humour; parts are a little bit gross; it sticks a middle finger up to a certain swathe of the population and dumps an impressive max win of 57,000x the bet on them. Beware the extreme volatility as usual, but if you can stomach that, then you should be able to stomach everything else Land Of The Free pours up on your plate."

Title: Fruit Smash

During this bonus, Giant Fruit symbols are guaranteed to land on each new free spin.Fast TrackIf the Fast Track menu is present, players can play Fruit Smash in the following three modes:Giant Fruit – costs 5x the bet for a spin with guaranteed Giant Fruit, RTP is 96.28%.Free Spins – buy a regular round of free spins for 100x the bet, RTP is 96.45%.Fruit Frenzy Free Spins – buy a round of Fruit Frenzy Free Spins for 500x the bet, RTP is 96.53%.Burst ModeIn Burst Mode, players select a stake level and a number of spins which is then played out without the game grid being present. Despite the general progression, there is, at times, a slight lack of the major individuality required to really make their games pop from the bunch. We've noticed a similar phenomenon while testing other games they've done, but perhaps the use of such common items as fruit exacerbated this impression.Familiarity hasn't damaged Fruit Smash's chances of being a fun slot to play, though, it must be said. Title: Boom Pirates
review: Medium/High,0.20/50,Out Now,7.5,"Boom Pirates (Foxium): OverviewFoxium, for those of you who don't know, is one of many independent studios recruited by Microgaming as part of an ongoing project in which Microgaming supplies the platform and know-how while its partnering studios focuses on creating exclusive content. While nearly all of these startups master the art of visual design, a less flattering common trait has been their inability to understand what makes a good slot. With that said, some of them are slowly but steadily starting to mature and grow into their shoes as proper slot makers. As a matter of fact, with the release of Boom Pirates, Foxium has taken a giant leap forward.For whatever reason, and we can only speculate, Boom Pirates has been delayed by nearly a year. Just by the look of it, you can tell it's quite an ambitious undertaking for such a small studio, but seeing that it comes with a new mechanic called Wonderways™, there could possibly have been some legal issue to sort out, as we've seen in other cases. Utilizing a default setup of 5-reels, 4-rows and 1024 ways to win, it piggybacks on the Megaways hype by offering up to a staggering 10,077,696 ways to win in fully extended mode. There are also plenty of unique features to benefit from such as the Boom Pirate feature that randomly activates extra rows and reels, as well as the Mary's Swashbuckling Attack that can randomly turn a non-winning spin into a five of a kind win. So, if you're up for some swashbuckling action, you can join the pirate crew from as little as 0.10 up to €30 per spin across all devices.The pirate topic never ceases to fascinate us. It's a well-liked theme that reflects our passion for adventure, mystery and travel - in Boom Pirates, we get a little bit of everything. Set on a tropical island surrounded by enchanting shades of blue, Foxium has created an utterly pleasant atmosphere here. Of course, there's also the customary pirate track playing in the background to really get you into plundering mode. On the wooden reels, symbols include 10 to A royal values as well as 5 more valuable picture symbols represented by gunpowder barrels, canons, colourful parrots, a tattooed pirate named Ben and, finally, Captain Mary. The latter is the most rewarding, giving you 25 times your stake for a nine of a kind combination. And nope, no wild symbols available here.Boom Pirates (Foxium): FeaturesFree spins featureThe first decision you'll have to make before embarking whether you want to play with the Foxify™ feature activated or not. If you do, it will increase the odds of triggering the free spins but will also increase your current bet size by 50%. If you want to skip waiting for the bonus to drop altogether, you can opt for the Buy Feature by clicking the gift button. This will cost you 100 times your stake.Before we attack the free spins, there are a couple of base game modifiers to wade through. First, there is the Boom Pirates feature which can come into play randomly on any spin. When activated, you'll hear a pirate call out ""boooooom pirates"" as the strategically parked pirate ship starts firing cannon balls onto the reels. As a result, this can extend the reel set up to 10,077,696 pay ways for that spin. Also randomly triggered, you may see Mary swing in on a rope following a non-winning spin to award a five of a kind win. This is known as Mary's Swashbuckling Attack.While it's possible to unlock the maximum pay ways in the base game, the Free Spins feature comes with a few added benefits. It comes into play when you land the 3 scatter symbols that together spell YO-HO-HO on reels 1, 3, and 5 simultaneously - this will give you 10 free spins (alternatively you can also buy the feature). During the round, additional tiles (paylines) can be randomly activated on the full 6x9 grid if hit by the bombardment of the pirate ship (it's more active during the free spins). Once these tiles (paylines) are activated, they remain active until the end of the round.Boom Pirates (Foxium): VerdictSo, was Boom Pirates worth the long wait? Indeed it was. It's undoubtedly fun to play, it looks fantastic, and there's an adequate amount of thrill and tension to keep you on your toes. Few games come without any downsides, however, and Boom Pirates has a few of these as well, although not everyone will be bothered by them.For such an ""open"" game with millions of possible paylines, it's surprisingly limiting on the player. The first demo we tried had a max win of 5000x which, even at that number, could be considered low for a game that aims to stand alongside the likes of Megaways. Offering up to 10 million ways to win but capping the game at 3,800x doesn't make much sense.  There are other limitations as well, such as the removal of wilds and the fact that you're required to land scatters on fixed reels as if it was some 9 payline slot.Overall, Boom Pirates is an excellent game, and if you're not provoked by its limitations, there's a good chance that you'll enjoy it a whole lot. The scenery is phenomenal, there's some comical elements to make you chuckle at times, and it can even offer you satisfyingly long sessions at times. In spite of its flaws, it's a confident yes from us."
